title: AI Project Club
text: AI Project Club is a regular in-person session where people bring a project, task, or idea they want to move forward using AI. It is for creatives, founders, freelancers, researchers, side-project people, and anyone curious about using AI more practically in their work. You do not need to be an expert. Bring a laptop, a project, and a willingness to experiment.

title: AI Project Club
text:
Who it is for?
This could be for you if you are:

writing, researching, designing, or creating content
testing a business or side-project idea
trying to use AI more effectively in your everyday workflow
looking for accountability and focused time to work
curious about AI but unsure how to apply it to real projects

title: AI Project Club
text:
What happens in a session?
Each session lasts around two hours and follows the following format:

welcome and intention setting
focused project work
townhall for optional sharing, questions, and group support

title: AI Project Club
text:
What to bring?

a laptop
access to any AI tool you already use, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Midjourney, Canva, Notion AI, or others
a project, task, question, or idea to work on
headphones if you like to focus quietly

title: AI Project Club
text:
Community expectations
We want this to be a friendly, respectful, and practical space. Share only what you are comfortable sharing. Respect other people’s ideas and privacy. Use AI tools thoughtfully, especially when working with personal, private, or sensitive information.
